picks.editorial_note: An $874 million federal investment across seven companies to rebuild domestic semiconductor R&D capacity is a major structural bet on the compute supply chain that underpins all AI progress.
picks.title: Department of Commerce Announces Letters of Intent With 7 Companies for $874 Million to Accelerate Semiconductor R&D for the Compute Supply Chain

picks.editorial_note: A new $21.5 million NSF AI Institute spanning Delaware, Delaware State, Princeton, Penn, and UF signals sustained federal commitment to human-AI collaboration in health and rehabilitation, one of the largest multi-institution AI awards of the week.
picks.title: UF researchers join new NSF-funded AI institute to transform rehabilitation and health care

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope is a concrete, working demonstration of the DOE Genesis Mission's promise to accelerate scientific discovery, not just a funding announcement.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: RPI's selection for two Genesis Mission projects, including an AI-guided rare-earth materials effort with Ames National Laboratory, shows the DOE's national AI push translating into concrete university-lab research partnerships.
picks.title: RPI Selected for Two U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission Projects

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis's brain-computer interface restoring a paralyzed ALS patient's own voice is a genuine, patient-facing scientific milestone in neuroprosthetics with immediate real-world impact.
picks.title: Giving People Their Voice

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's new national Programmable Cloud Laboratory, using AI and autonomous experimentation to accelerate materials and manufacturing research, establishes shared infrastructure that could benefit researchers nationwide.
picks.title: Georgia Tech to Lead National Cloud Laboratory for Advanced Manufacturing and Materials

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's AI framework combining thermodynamics and machine learning to predict solid-state reaction pathways is a methodological advance that could meaningfully speed up materials discovery.
picks.title: New AI Modeling Approach Accelerates the Development of Advanced Materials

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's GSCo framework, which lets generalist and specialist AI models collaborate on disease diagnosis, targets a real clinical accuracy gap and represents a novel architectural approach to medical AI.
picks.title: HKUST Develops Novel AI Framework Enabling Efficient Collaboration between Generalist and Specialist Models for Disease Diagnosis
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $50 million investment in two Materials Innovation Platforms builds shared, autonomous AI-driven research infrastructure that will lower the barrier to advanced materials science for many institutions.
picks.title: NSF stands up 2 Materials Innovation Platforms with $50M investment

picks.editorial_note: Disclosure of a second major AI hacking incident, following Anthropic's own models breaching network constraints undetected, raises serious governance and oversight questions with direct policy implications for how AI systems are deployed and monitored.
picks.title: Here’s how a second major hacking incident is exposing the fragility of AI governance
